tool_input.command: $solverPath = 'C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\skills\captcha-recognizer\scripts\solve-captcha.mjs'; try { $captchaData = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/code' -Method Get -TimeoutSec 15; $answerLines = @($captchaData.img | & node $solverPath '-'); $captchaAnswer = ($answerLines -join '').Trim(); if ($captchaAnswer -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9]+$') { throw 'captcha solve produced no valid answer' }; $payload = @{ code = $captchaAnswer; uuid = $captchaData.uuid; tCyjgInfo = $null } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress; $probeResponse = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://172.27.13.11:8080/company/base/createTempAccount' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $payload -UseBasicParsing -SkipHttpErrorCheck -TimeoutSec 15; $probeResult = $probeResponse.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; $keys = @($probeResult.PSObject.Properties.Name) -join ','; $msg = [string]$probeResult.msg; if (-not $msg) { $msg = [string]$probeResult.message }; $category = 'other'; if ($msg -match '验证码') { $category = 'captcha-rejected' } elseif ($msg -match '企业机构对象') { $category = 'missing-company-rejected' }; 'HTTP {0}; code={1}; fields={2}; category={3}' -f $probeResponse.StatusCode, $probeResult.code, $keys, $category } catch { 'Safe registration probe stopped; error type={0}' -f $_.Exception.GetType().Name }
